_about: Happy Photo Organizer's drill manifest (UPDATE_DRILL 5a). Read by drills/kit/Invoke-Drill.ps1; the HPO-specific steps are in drills/hpo.ps1. No secrets here, ever.
_launcher_note: Stage-Drill writes C:\Users\Public\Drills\HPO.cmd for the house runner (RUN-ALL.cmd). No DRILL-NEEDS-NICK: nothing in v1.065 -> v1.066 waits for a press (the fixtures write the API key, so Settings does not open; the busy step closes it with WM_CLOSE). No DRILL-TIMEOUT-MIN: the runner's 120 min is above the harness's own limits for a normal run.
version_probe: update.log: '<ISO> STARTED <version> <exe>' written by every start (v1.066+)
update_trigger: automatic: checked at start (drill mode) and every 5 minutes; installs by itself once downloaded, verified and the app is idle
_sentinels_note: byte-identical files only. auth.json is NOT one: the app saves its window position into it on every start, so it is checked field by field in Get-FixtureReport instead.
_tree_allowlist_note: uninstall.bat names its own folder; the catalog carries the job the user taught the app (until a later release moves it out of the install tree - bug U8).
relaunch: the installer's launch_app() after the swap
busy_description: Settings dialog open - no API key saved, so the app opens Settings at start
not_covered: profile path: the drill account is plain ASCII 'drill' (C:\Users\drill); the ship PC's Windows username has not been read, so a profile path with a space or Thai characters is NOT covered by this drill (UPDATE_DRILL 5.2)
the 'Install now' button: in v1.066 it matters only while the app is busy, where it refuses (unit test test_the_install_button_refuses_while_busy_and_says_why), so it is not driven here
v1.066's own updater against real GitHub: every check on v1.066 runs through the loopback feed; tools/publish_release.py reads the real endpoint back after publishing

a failed install: the attempt record (update-attempt.json), no automatic retry of that version, the Retry button, and a pre-v1.066 app relaunched with its update checks paused for that session are unit-tested only; the drill runs the success path
_from_route_note: v1.065 has no drill feed; it does honour HAPPY_UPDATE_REPO, so its own updater fetches the candidate from the public test repo drill_repo. From v1.066 on, kind 'feed' (the loopback feed) is enough.
